change: Selectively port Sloppy d19f386 array swap: bounds checks once, mutable data detachment once, then exchange elements through the buffer. No new API. Add a matching C/Dewy swap benchmark and independent Python-derived 1000-iteration checksum.

validation.coverage: Native/WebAssembly default/release: copy isolation, managed record/array fields, stateful closure copies, self swaps, negative/out-of-range/empty indices.
validation.bootstrap: Two native generations seeded from the preceding independently bootstrapped 6,359-test stage. Full suite at the next coherent library batch.

performance: Ten million swaps: default about 54.3 -> 41.8 ms, release 45.2 -> 41.8 ms, C 28.0 ms. About 23%/7% faster; still about 1.50x C. All 28 preceding benchmark artifacts match with fresh checksums; only the two new swap artifacts differ. Compilation instruction differences range from -0.006% to +0.028%; this is diagnostic, not a new wall-time acceptance campaign.
benchmark_setup: Two attempts failed before timing because & in a declaration was treated as an overload group. Benchmark now uses documented integer and spelling on all variants. No parser/language rule changed.
baseline: Fixed ea1cba0e and accepted cd07ea34 unchanged; no whole-stage promotion.
